QuestInfo.name: Getting to Know Your Bits: Equipping Bits
QuestInfo.1: Open the Bits window and equip some Bits.
QuestInfo.2: Now you know how to open Bits UI and equip new Bits.

0.0: Easy, right? Just don't lose your Bit-Cases or you'll lose those cool effects.\r\n#i3800450#
0.1: One more thing!\r\nYou can't equip Bit-Cases that are smaller than the one you already have on. You want a smaller case, you gotta unequip ALL of your Bits first.\r\n#i3800449#
0.2: Whew, that made ME want to take a nap. I hate explaining things for more than four lines. I'm gonna give you these Bits thingies and you can figure it out, okay?

no.0: What is it with you and not taking gifts?

yes.0: Get out there and collect those Bits!
